remarks: You could be the lucky tenant to be the first to rent this sparkling and tastefully updated large one bedroom unit in Woodside Green. Freshly painted and gleaming, this corner unit is flooded with natural light. The charm of the high ceilings, an entry foyer, arches, a separate dining room ( or dedicated home office space), a large living room, a bedroom with two closets, hardwood floors throughout and a gorgeous new bathroom and kitchen will delight you. Hot-Water, parking and cooking gas are included in the monthly rent. Communal laundry room and mail room. Wonderful location - across the street from Ridgeway Shopping Center and walkable to downtown restaurants, library etc. Located on the second floor - no elevator. Very Good credit and references are a MUST. No pets allowed. Option for a second car park space $100. $100 Move In charge applies to tenant.
